comment: The HMIS is described as shared infrastructure because it supports several domains. Reuse across domains alone may not be sufficient to classify an operational analytics and reporting system as DPI-H. The distinction between an HMIS as a shared service and DHIS2 or similar operational implementations requires greater precision.

public.text: The HMIS is described as shared infrastructure because it supports several domains. Reuse across domains alone may not be sufficient to classify an operational analytics and reporting system as DPI-H. The distinction between an HMIS as a shared service and DHIS2 or similar operational implementations requires greater precision.
public.suggestedRevision: Define which HMIS capabilities qualify as DPI-H, such as shared indicator definitions, aggregate data services, and reusable reporting infrastructure, and which programme-specific dashboards or workflows remain functional applications.
